import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static String[] sci = new String[15];
    static String[] cap = new String[15];
    static int[][] dis = new int[15][15];
    static int[][] dis2 = new int[15][15];

    static int[] dx = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, 1, -1};

    static class FlowEdge {
        int v, u;
        long cap, flow = 0;
        FlowEdge(int v, int u, long cap) {
            this.v = v;
            this.u = u;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        final long flow_inf = (long)1e18;
        List<FlowEdge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        List<List<Integer>> adj = new ArrayList<>();
        int n, m = 0, s, t;
        int[] level;
        int[] ptr;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();

        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            this.n = n;
            this.s = s;
            this.t = t;
            for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void add_edge(int v, int u, long cap) {
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(v, u, cap));
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(u, v, 0));
            adj.get(v).add(m);
            adj.get(u).add(m + 1);
            m += 2;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            for (int i=0; i<n; i++) level[i] = -1;
            level[s] = 0;
            q.clear();
            q.offer(s);
            while(!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for(int id : adj.get(v)) {
                    if (edges.get(id).cap - edges.get(id).flow < 1)
                        continue;
                    if (level[edges.get(id).u] != -1)
                        continue;
                    level[edges.get(id).u] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.offer(edges.get(id).u);
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int v, long pushed) {
            if (pushed == 0) return 0;
            if (v == t) return pushed;
            for (; ptr[v] < adj.get(v).size(); ptr[v]++) {
                int id = adj.get(v).get(ptr[v]);
                int u = edges.get(id).u;
                if (level[v] + 1 != level[u] || edges.get(id).cap - edges.get(id).flow < 1)
                    continue;
                long tr = dfs(u, Math.min(pushed, edges.get(id).cap - edges.get(id).flow));
                if (tr == 0) continue;
                edges.get(id).flow += tr;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= tr;
                return tr;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long flow() {
            long f = 0;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(level, -1);
                if (!bfs()) break;
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = dfs(s, flow_inf)) != 0) {
                    f += pushed;
                }
            }
            return f;
        }
    }

    static boolean isValid(int x, int y) {
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= n || y >= n) return false;
        char c = sci[x].charAt(y);
        return !(c == 'Y' || c == 'Z');
    }

    static void bfs1(int x, int y) {
        int[][] localDis = new int[n][n];
        for (int[] row : localDis) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{x, y});
        localDis[x][y] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] u = q.poll();
            int ux = u[0], uy = u[1];
            for (int i=0; i<4; i++) {
                int vx = ux + dx[i];
                int vy = uy + dy[i];
                if (isValid(vx, vy) && localDis[vx][vy] == -1) {
                    localDis[vx][vy] = localDis[ux][uy] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{vx, vy});
                }
            }
        }
        for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for(int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                dis[i][j] = (localDis[i][j] == -1) ? (int)1e9 : localDis[i][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static int[][][] dp = new int[65][12][12];

    static int pos(int tt, int x0, int y0, int x, int y) {
        if (dis[x0][y0] < tt) return 0;
        if (x0 == x && y0 == y) return 1;
        if (tt >= t) return 0;
        if (dis[x0][y0] <= tt) return 0;
        if (dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] != -1) return dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y];
        for (int j=0; j<4; j++) {
            int xx = x0 + dx[j];
            int yy = y0 + dy[j];

            if (xx<0 || xx>=n || yy<0 || yy>=n) continue;
            if (sci[xx].charAt(yy)=='Y') continue;
            if (sci[xx].charAt(yy)=='Z') continue;

            if (pos(tt + 1, xx, yy, x, y) == 1) {
                dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] = 1;
                return 1;
            }
        }
        dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] = 0;
        return 0;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            sci[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            cap[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for(int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                if (sci[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    bfs1(i,j);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        List<int[]> sc = new ArrayList<>();
        List<int[]> cp = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                char c = sci[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') {
                    sc.add(new int[]{i,j});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                char c = cap[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') {
                    cp.add(new int[]{i,j});
                }
            }
        }
        int totalVertices = sc.size() + cp.size() + 2;
        int sNode = 0;
        int tNode = totalVertices - 1;
        Dinic flow = new Dinic(totalVertices, sNode, tNode);
        for(int i=0; i<sc.size(); i++) {
            long c = sci[sc.get(i)[0]].charAt(sc.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            flow.add_edge(sNode, i+1, c);
        }
        for(int i=0; i<cp.size(); i++) {
            long c = cap[cp.get(i)[0]].charAt(cp.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            flow.add_edge(sc.size() + 1 + i, sc.size() + cp.size() + 1, c);
        }
        for (int i=0; i<sc.size(); i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<cp.size(); j++) {
                if (pos(0, sc.get(i)[0], sc.get(i)[1], cp.get(j)[0], cp.get(j)[1]) == 1) {
                    flow.add_edge(i+1, sc.size()+1+j, 10000000);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(flow.flow());
    }
}
